hooks.name: Frontend: lint/build on save
hooks.description: Targets EntraUi (Angular 19). Fires when a TypeScript, template, or stylesheet file under EntraUi/ is saved. This project uses plain CSS (src/styles.css and component .css files), not SCSS, so the matcher targets .css. Runs the Angular build to surface compile/template/type errors early. NOTE: this project has no `lint` npm script and no ESLint config, so we run the existing `build` script (ng build) instead of `ng lint`. PostFileSave matchers are tested against the FILE PATH.
